metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.5 · 1968 · The Love Bug
metas.description: Down-on-his-luck race car driver Jim Douglas teams up with a little VW Bug that has a mind of it's own, not realizing Herbie's worth until a sneaky rival plots to steal him.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.7 · 1974 · Herbie Rides Again
metas.description: The living Volkswagen Beetle helps an old lady protect her home from a corrupt developer.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.7 · 1977 · Herbie Goes to Monte Carlo
metas.description: Herbie, the Volkswagen Beetle with a mind of its own, is racing in the Monte Carlo Rally. Unbeknownst to Herbie's driver, thieves have hidden a stolen diamond in Herbie's gas tank, and are now trying to get it back.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 4.9 · 1980 · Herbie Goes Bananas
metas.description: The adorable little VW helps its owners break up a counterfeiting ring in Mexico.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.0 · 2005 · Herbie: Fully Loaded
metas.description: Maggie Peyton, the new owner of Herbie, Number 53, the free-wheelin' Volkswagen bug with a mind of its own, puts the car through its paces on the road to becoming a NASCAR competitor.
